# SendGrid Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill for Twilio SendGrid: send email (plain text or HTML, attachments included), check email statistics, and read your profile. Sending is a write — the skill requires exact confirmation of recipient, subject, and body before sending, and blocks unverified senders and BCC mass-sending by default. Honest note: SendGrid's free tier covers 100 emails a day; the sender address must belong to a domain you've verified. Draft: written from SendGrid's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
